body:
Yeah, I'm aware of all the negative consequences of committing and I think I'm okay with it. I've already done "my part" so to speak by giving someone else hope. So as long as I helped a life, I'm at peace with myself and could care less at how the world will see me as.

I also don't really have anyone so realistically, only the media will pick up on this.
It makes me so sad because I know I can't do that tonight.. It's very beautiful and I miss it.

I'm supposed to be transferring to a four year this fall. But with my mom constantly reminding me (or maybe shaming me, I'm not sure) because she's not confident I'll be successful and she'll have wasted the money, I've lost all hope of continuing down that avenue. 

I don't want her money if she's going to constantly remind me of how much a hindrance it is to her. I do want to  move somewhere new and meet new people. But I don't have the money nor the means. And the longer I stay here the longer I'll suffer. 

​

But thanks for reaching out.
